name: Shatterstar

abilityDetails.Glancing: Sıyırma vuruşları kritik olamaz, %50 azalmış hasar verir ve saldırı yetenek doğruluğu %100 düşer.
abilityDetails.Daunted: Rakibin özel saldırılar sonrasında hasar almasını kolaylaştırır.
abilityDetails.Reckless: Ağır saldırı kullanma şansını artırır, blok vuran saldırılarda saldırı gücünü azaltır.
abilityDetails.Uncanny: Özel saldırıların harcadığı gücü belirtilen miktarda azaltır ve düşük güç seviyesinde etkinleştirilmesine izin verir.
abilityDetails.Instant Bleed: Zamanla doğrudan fiziksel kanama hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Cross-Fight Ability: Saldıran veya savunan şampiyona uygulanabilen ve bir görev içinde birden fazla dövüş boyunca süren yetenek.

signatureAbility:
Mojoworld Gladiator
Overstacking Shatterstar's Daunted Debuffs inflicts a bonus [5.02 - 15.04]% Daunted Passive for 10 seconds. Max stacks: 4.
Shatterstar's superstar status in the Mojoverse allows him to provide a Cross-Fight Sponsorship offer in the Pre-Fight screen. A Sponsor can only be used once per Quest.
The next Mutant or Mystic Champion that enters a fight with a Sponsor signs a deal and causes incoming Bleed Debuffs from Quest Nodes to suffer 80% reduced potency for the next 4 fights.

abilitySections.title: Brought to You by Mojovision - Always Active
content: Due to Mojovision's strict censorship guidelines, incoming Bleed effects suffer 100% reduced potency.
Incoming Poison and Incinerate Debuffs from Quest Nodes suffer 40% reduced potency. This is doubled in Alliance War.

abilitySections.title: Glancing
content: Holding Block for 0.3 seconds grants a 100% Glancing Passive until Shatterstar stops Blocking..

When the Opponent Glances against Shatterstar, Offensive Ability Accuracy is reduced by 25% and damage is reduced by 0% or 25% against Skill Champions. Damage is reduced by an additional 5% per Daunted on the Opponent up to 60% total.
Shatterstar's personal Glances consume 1 Combo from the Opponent's Combo Meter. Consume 1 additional Combo from Special Attack Glances.

abilitySections.title: Daunted Debuffs - Max: 10
content: Shatterstar's Daunted Debuffs have 20% potency and last 10 to 5 seconds depending on how many are already active.
Personal Daunted Debuffs expire one at a time and are paused during Special Attacks and Strikers.
Against non-Tech Champions, personal Daunted Debuffs cannot have their duration lowered, and they cannot be Purified during Shatterstar's Heavy Attack.
Interrupting the Opponent's Heavy Attack inflicts 2 Daunteds.
When Shatterstar or his Opponent's Combo Meter reaches a multiple of 10, inflict 1 Daunted. Inflict 1 additional Daunted if this happens during Shatterstar's Heavy or Special Attack.

abilitySections.title: Daunted Effects - While Active on the Opponent
content: At 2+ Daunteds: Blocking 2 consecutive Basic Attacks inflicts a non-stacking 10% Reckless Passive for 3 seconds.
At 4+ Daunteds: Gain a Pursuit Passive against non-Tech Champions.
At 6+ Daunteds: As an Attacker with 2 Bars of Power that hasn't used their Special Attack 3, gain a 40% Uncanny Passive.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1 - Spinning Blades
content: Each hit inflicts an Instant Bleed dealing [2,280.08] Direct Damage, plus an additional [2,280.08] for each Uncanny effect on Shatterstar.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2 - Force of Will
content: After activation, gain a non-stacking 10% Uncanny Passive for 20 seconds.
The final two hits inflict Instant Bleeds, each dealing [10,364] Direct Damage.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3 - Primetime Television
content: This Special Attack can only be used once per fight.
Gain 2 indefinite 10% Uncanny Passives.
